title: The idle-lane archive can judge a lane whose step is not on the record branch
why: 54 idle lanes read "unknown" because their steps are not on the record branch, so the idle-lane archive cannot judge them. Runner 8, 02:00 CST Nov 8, via coordinator 01:58 CST.
note: Fix: first list the 54 lanes and why each has no step (another repo's lane, an old c-number, a lane started with no step); then give each a step or a rule that judges it another way, such as its PR state. Related: step live-file-archive-fields (ready) and done step one-lane-one-step. Queue fix (owner 13:20 CST Nov 7). Slug and title by triage. Filed 02:22 CST Nov 8. Lane session_013NEJL1VtpMs3Aw5JLtyvVD started it (coordinator, 01:59 CST Nov 8). Built as #1846 and #1851, with runner 8 (coordinator, 03:13 CST Nov 8). After they merge, 43 lanes print hold lines: 42 name a step never filed, 1 names deleted step model-guard-reads-next (b67c48d3f); 23 carry another repo's tag (degen 13, q_max 6). Triage reads each from the lane's inventory and files a done step or points the lane at its repo's step; unknown ones go to the coordinator. Follow-up (`Merge after: #1861`, on the build.py stack, not after closed #1889): the "also tagged" hold text in build.py and SKILL.md disagree; align them (lane, 05:40 CST Nov 8).
